title: Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State
abstract: arXiv:2610.00232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

translated_title: 恒定记忆召回：固定矩阵状态中的习得联想
translated_abstract: 固定大小的循环记忆限制了推理过程中存储的增长，但成功的召回依赖于具体任务和训练方式。我们研究了一个带有固定token特定键偏置的小型DeltaNet变体，并训练它在每个序列中记住32个新的键值配对。仅使用32 KiB的循环矩阵状态，该模型在三个训练种子下，从序列的值中进行选择时平均准确率达到99.95%。当用填充内容将查询前的上下文扩展至1,798个token（不增加新的配对）时，召回率仍接近完美。而将第一个记忆块清零则会消除这种召回能力。一项探索性的48对测试在消耗主训练预算的四分之一后仍接近随机水平，且未能定位出容量极限。参数量匹配的向量和Transformer基线均保持在接近随机的水平，即使在经过额外的训练搜索后Transformer依然如此。这一尚未解决的基线失败问题使得无法进行记忆效率方面的比较。
tldr: 该论文证明了一个带固定token特定键偏置的DeltaNet变体仅用32 KiB的固定矩阵状态就能以99.95%的准确率召回每个序列中的32个键值配对，而参数量匹配的向量和Transformer基线均接近随机水平，表明循环矩阵状态具备惊人的恒定记忆存储能力。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases can recall 32 key-value pairs per sequence with 99.95% accuracy using only a fixed 32 KiB recurrent matrix state, while parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, revealing remarkable constant-memory storage capacity in recurrent matrix states.
